entries.title: New shared/core files landed

ai.title: Add Reddit subreddit campaign utilities and promotion evasion checks
ai.summary: Introduces a new module in `common/src/util/` containing helpers for Reddit campaigns that target a subreddit link instead of a fixed post. Defines `SUBREDDIT_CAMPAIGN_ACTIONS` to restrict valid actions to comment and post, and `parseSubredditUrl` to normalize various subreddit link formats into a canonical URL. Implements `subredditCampaign` to identify stored campaigns by their canonical link, action type, and preview author, and `promotionEvasionReason` to detect briefs requesting moderation evasion, extra accounts, or hidden sponsorship.
ai.evidence: New file `common/src/util/reddit-campaign.ts` defines `SUBREDDIT_CAMPAIGN_ACTIONS`, `parseSubredditUrl`, `subredditCampaign`, `parseRedditThingUrl`, and `promotionEvasionReason`, which are asserted by the new test suite `common/src/util/__tests__/reddit-campaign.test.ts`.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the server-side consumer of `isSubredditCampaignSql` mentioned in the comments, nor the specific rollout schedule for this new campaign type.

eli5.text: Advertisers buying Reddit placements can now ask people to reply to a thread or start a new post in a chosen subreddit instead of pointing to one fixed link. The system includes a safety check that stops any brief asking people to sneak past moderators, use extra accounts, or hide that the post is sponsored. This is an internal update for the team that manages these ads; it does not change what you see or do in your own coding sessions.
